title: Power-Performance Characterization of TinyML Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.21646v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: TinyML systems are enabling machine learning (ML) inference at the edge. However, there is little quantitative analysis of such systems. This paper presents a systematic performance and power characterization of diverse TinyML applications on microcontrollers (MCUs), spanning neural network models, software libraries, operating systems, and hardware architectures. We focus on the impact of the multiple layers of abstraction that provide higher programmability at the expense of performance and energy efficiency. We propose a model to estimate the costs of different abstraction layers and make recommendations for minimizing those costs. Our findings can help designers with Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and CNN inference optimization on edge devices.

translated_title: TinyML系统的功耗与性能特征分析
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.21646v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：TinyML系统正在推动边缘端的机器学习（ML）推理。然而，对此类系统的定量分析很少。本文对微控制器（MCU）上各种TinyML应用进行了系统的性能和功耗特征分析，涵盖了神经网络模型、软件库、操作系统和硬件架构。我们重点研究了多层抽象的影响，这些抽象层以牺牲性能和能效为代价提供了更高的可编程性。我们提出了一个模型来估算不同抽象层的成本，并提出了最小化这些成本的建议。我们的发现可以帮助设计人员进行边缘设备上的神经架构搜索（NAS）和CNN推理优化。
tldr: 本文系统分析了TinyML系统在微控制器上的性能和功耗，提出了估算抽象层成本的模型，并给出了优化建议，以辅助边缘设备上的神经架构搜索和CNN推理优化。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically characterizes performance and power of TinyML systems on MCUs, proposes a cost estimation model for abstraction layers, and offers optimization recommendations to aid NAS and CNN inference on edge devices.
